{
  "id": "trellis2-native",
  "family": "trellis2-native",
  "genre": "3d",
  "label": "TRELLIS.2 Native",
  "description": "Image to textured 3D mesh (native ComfyUI TRELLIS.2): background-removed conditioning \u2192 voxel structure \u2192 shape latent \u2192 texture atlas, saved as a .glb.",
  "source": {
    "type": ""
  },
  "defaults": {
    "resolution": 1024,
    "bg_removal": "auto",
    "steps": 12,
    "cfg": 7.5,
    "shape_steps": 20,
    "shape_cfg": 7.5,
    "tex1_steps": 12,
    "tex1_cfg": 7.5,
    "tex2_steps": 12,
    "tex2_cfg": 1.0,
    "remesh_resolution": 768,
    "decimate_faces": 700000,
    "smooth_angle": 180,
    "atlas_size": 4096,
    "ao_size": 1024,
    "normal_size": 2048,
    "struct_sampler": "euler",
    "struct_scheduler": "normal",
    "shape_sampler": "euler",
    "shape_scheduler": "normal",
    "tex1_sampler": "euler",
    "tex1_scheduler": "simple",
    "tex2_sampler": "euler",
    "tex2_scheduler": "normal",
    "sd3_shift": 5.0,
    "rescale_struct": 0.7,
    "rescale_shape": 0.5,
    "override_struct": 0.667,
    "override_shape": 0.769,
    "seed": 42
  },
  "engine": "comfyui",
  "form": "form_img_to_mesh",
  "has_inference": false,
  "has_rubric": false
}
